reasons: The loaves are explicitly identified as Yonah’s scarce lunch in scene 9: “Five barley loaves and two fish… definitely not enough,” then Andrew receives it with care.
Jesus lifts the loaves in scene 11, after which they appear as “warm barley loaves, enough for many,” making them central to the miracle.
They recur across scenes 8, 9, and 11 and are passed from Yonah toward Andrew/Jesus, then become food Miri distributes to the children.
story_role: the humble lunch multiplied to feed many
